name: Mahou Shoujo Y
source:
This visual novel follows two college students who become magical girls and are forced to fight against sinister forces together. Alongside the two protagonists, other magical girls will appear throughout the story, helping in battles and playing important roles in the plot.

The powers of heroes and villains are tied to a specific form of art or activity. Sofia’s abilities are inspired by figure skating, while Lana’s magic comes from drawing.
